title: Build the existing Rust planner with the supported Emscripten loader
description: Own flake.nix, flake.lock, any required default.nix, package.json and dependency locks, wrangler.toml, src/worker.mjs bootstrap only, rust/clock-wasm manifest/lock and entrypoint, build scripts, and necessary gitignore additions. Pin Emscripten >=6.0.10 and matching wasm-bindgen crate/CLI; preserve typed_handle_http and typed_render_sse exports through supported Emscripten bindings. Retain host HTTP/ASSETS/SSE behavior and browser assets. Use project dev shell; do not directly read/scan/touch /nix paths. No new handwritten Python or JS tests, no cargo test/check/clippy, no deployment or commit/push. Parent owns integration/deploy/docs; test child owns .justfile and live-test scripts. Activity: docs/activity/.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned project shell supplies matching compiler and bindgen; release wasm32-unknown-emscripten binary and generated JS build; Worker uses generated exports and required runtime flags. Build success is not HTTP or deploy acceptance.
notes: Pinned Rust 1.97 Emscripten standard library, bindgen crate/CLI 0.2.129, and Emscripten 6.0.10 with the matching fixed-hash official LLVM 24 SDK. LLVM 22 could not compile required builtins. Added the empty binary entrypoint while retaining the existing rlib; replaced only the manual Worker module bootstrap with generated imports. The build copies the JS/Wasm pair and required snippets only. Selected pinned Wrangler 4.148/workerd 1.20261006.1 and explicit new_module_registry/nodejs_compat after the older runtime rejected the required date. Release build, ShellCheck, real HTTP integration and dry run passed. Cloudflare version 4a855d4d-d18b-4cda-88ec-a5817b159cbb is active at 100 percent. SDK build host is x86_64-linux. Browser assets and ADRs remain unchanged.
close_reason: Verified build and live HTTP acceptance; evidence in the release activity note.

title: Resolve shared Dolt remote sync failure for edge-clock
description: On 2026-10-20, bd sync --remote origin --no-adopt --json and bd dolt push --remote origin --no-adopt --json failed with Error 1105 (HY000): failed to get remote db; git not found on PATH. Live routing is server mode on doltsrv.lan:3307, database edge_clock. The origin Dolt remote is already configured as git+ssh://git@github.com/bogorad/edge-clock.git; ordinary issue reads and writes work. At the user request, plain bd-init later completed with exit 0: it repaired local connection settings and installed chained Beads/pre-commit export hooks. Existing project identity and issue states were preserved. A subsequent explicit remote sync still failed with the same missing git error. No database reset, new tracker, or remote repair was run. Investigate the shared service command environment and intended remote-sync policy under separate authority. Do not recreate the database or blindly re-add origin. Evidence: docs/activity/2026-10-20-19-28-bd-init.md and docs/activity/2026-10-20-19-14-beads-sync-limitation.md.
close_reason: Invalid issue, closed at the operator request. Shared-server Beads writes are immediately visible and require no routine sync, push or pull. This issue came from unnecessary agent-run sync commands; their failure is not a project blocker and requires no repair for this workflow.
